root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: NODE_IS_REFERENCED(node) implies *used = TRUE for a BAG_MEMORY capture that is neither BACKREF nor CALLED.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the look-behind liveness walk returns on a BAG_MEMORY capture, check_node_in_look_behind() must raise *used when NODE_IS_REFERENCED(node) is true even if NODE_IS_BACKREF(node) and NODE_IS_CALLED(node) are both false, so the later look-behind rewrite cannot treat a still-referenced capture as dead.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original executes the BAG_MEMORY used-check with NODE_IS_REFERENCED(node)=1 and leaves *used=0, violating the missing source-level conjunct at the root-cause site. The fixed original executes the same source event with NODE_IS_REFERENCED(node)=1 and *used=1, satisfying the obligation before any later rewrite/free on that capture can happen.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: vulnerable original: look_behind_used_check.used_after_check=0 < look_behind_used_check.node_is_referenced=1; fixed original: look_behind_used_check.used_after_check=1 >= look_behind_used_check.node_is_referenced=1.

nodes.state: onig_node_free() is invoked on the REFERENCED BAG_MEMORY capture itself, ending the lifetime of the same capture object that the vulnerable look-behind used-check left unmarked.
nodes.evidence: vulnerable original: look_behind_used_check.capture_ptr=0x607000000480 == free_referenced_capture.freed_capture_ptr=0x607000000480 at ordered event indices 6 -> 7.

nodes.state: After the free, the NODE_CALL case reloads the freed capture pointer from NODE_BODY(node) into local t, re-materializing the stale alias that feeds the recursive sink call.
nodes.evidence: vulnerable original: free_referenced_capture.freed_capture_ptr=0x607000000480 == stale_call_body_load.call_body_ptr=0x607000000480 at ordered event indices 7 -> 9.

nodes.state: The recursive node_min_byte_len() entry reaches the AddressSanitizer-reported NODE_TYPE(node) read with the same stale capture pointer that was just reloaded from the call body.
nodes.evidence: vulnerable original: stale_call_body_load.call_body_ptr=0x607000000480 == sink_type_read.node_ptr=0x607000000480 at ordered event indices 9 -> 10.

edges.relation: The same BAG_MEMORY capture pointer that the vulnerable look-behind used-check leaves unmarked is later the capture object passed into onig_node_free(), tying the missing liveness obligation to the lifetime-ending free on that exact node.
edges.evidence: vulnerable original: look_behind_used_check.capture_ptr=0x607000000480 == free_referenced_capture.freed_capture_ptr=0x607000000480 with ordered event indices 6 -> 7.

edges.relation: The exact capture pointer whose lifetime ends in onig_node_free() is later reloaded from NODE_BODY(node) into local t, proving the call-body load occurs after the free on the same heap object.
edges.evidence: vulnerable original: free_referenced_capture.freed_capture_ptr=0x607000000480 == stale_call_body_load.call_body_ptr=0x607000000480 with ordered event indices 7 -> 9.

edges.relation: The stale Node* t loaded from NODE_BODY(node) is passed unchanged into the recursive node_min_byte_len() call that immediately executes the sink NODE_TYPE(node) read.
edges.evidence: vulnerable original: stale_call_body_load.call_body_ptr=0x607000000480 == sink_type_read.node_ptr=0x607000000480 with ordered event indices 9 -> 10.
